title: Deadline Coming June 24 for the Weed Challenge
content: Friday is the deadline for theWeed Painting Challenge. It's free to enter, all media are accepted, and if you win, you get one of the rare "Department of Art" patches.Here's the previous post:Weed Painting ChallengeFacebook Event Pagewhere people are posting their results.And there are some amazing results that people are posting. But don't be intimidated if you're new at outdoor painting. You'll get lots of feedback and encouragement from the community. We're all trying to push the boundary of what we can do. I'll go through and press "like" and comment after all the pieces are in.
